text:
maria: FYI seeing ExternalSecrets controller entering backoff loops for multiple secrets during a mass rotation (payments svc). Strange spike around 08:12 UTC.
aj: ugh, saw alerts. what error in logs?
infra-bot: [external-secrets-controller] 2026-01-12T08:12:04Z ERROR reconcile secret/payments/stripe-token: retried 5 times: received 429 from vault: rate limited, retrying after backoff
aj: looks like Vault returned 429 and ES controller is backing off exponentially. Are we hitting Vault qps or an envoy rate limit?
tanner: my guess: Vault rate limit. Last change introduced parallel token fetcher in the TF apply for rotation. We should throttle ES controller concurrency or add jitter.
maria: can we patch controller config live to drop `concurrentSyncs` to 2 and set `retryBackoff`? Also check externalsecret annotation for per-secret backoff.
nisarg: i can patch for prod. what's the helm value?
tanner: in helm values it's `controller.concurrentSyncs` and `controller.retryBackoff` (seconds). Try:
```
controller:
  concurrentSyncs: 2
  retryBackoff: 5
```
aj: also add annotation on SecretStore to increase vault client backoff? maybe `external-secrets.io/vault-backoff` ??? not sure
maria: AWS secrets-manager has `reconcile.retries` but Vault plugin doesn't. We used `secretStore.externalSecrets.io/retry` placeholder earlier.
infra-bot: deploy job started: helm upgrade --install externalsecrets ./charts/externalsecrets --namespace external-secrets (job id c3f2)
aj: any reason not to just stagger the rotation in the rotation controller? we can kick off payments rotation in small batches.
nisarg: agree. I'll patch controller to concurrentSyncs=2 and bump retryBackoff to 6 now, then monitor.
maria: patch + monitor sounds good. can you also open a TF change to set helm values for future deploys? keep it small.
nisarg: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4521 - sets values and documents why. will link monitor graphs.
tanner: we should also add a per-externalsecret annotation to opt-out of fast retry during rotation, maybe `externalsecrets.redwood.com/rotation-batch: "small"`
aj: ok add that in the payments rotation job template.
sre-oncall: monitoring: seeing 95th latency drop after patch (08:18) :thumbsup:
maria: perfect. follow up: make note to check Vault rate limit quotas and request bump if pattern repeats.
aj: Thanks. closing for now unless someone sees repeat.
nisarg: will leave watch for 30m and report back.
maria: :eyes:
